help.title: Help
help.subtitle: Learn how to get the most out of Ascend.

whatIs.title: What is Ascend?
whatIs.body: Ascend is a League of Legends self-coaching desktop app. It helps you improve through a structured workflow: assessments, focused sessions, game reviews, detailed stats, and progression tracking over time — all local-first, with no cloud dependency.
whatIs.why: No more scattered tools: one place to set your focus areas, review your games, and measure your progress.

workflow.title: How does it work?
workflow.body: The Ascend improvement cycle has 5 steps:
steps: Periodic Fundamental Assessment — Rate your skills across the game's core fundamentals when you feel you've reached a milestone, or periodically.
Session — Pick one or more objectives and start playing.
Recording — Auto-record your games or link external VODs for later review.
Review — After each game, score your KPIs, add timestamped notes, and rate your objectives.
Stats — Check detailed game stats and progression trends at the end of each session.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.body: An overview of your progress: level, streak, suggested next session, recent results, and quick trends.
dashboard.why: See everything that matters at a glance before you queue up.

session.title: Session
session.body: Create a practice session by selecting one or more objectives (fundamentals). Ascend auto-detects when your games end and prompts you to review them.
session.why: Stay focused on specific goals instead of playing on autopilot.

record.title: Recording
record.body: Auto-record your games with the built-in capture (ffmpeg). You can also manually link video files or YouTube/Insight Capture links. Recordings are tied to games for easy review access.
record.why: Having the VOD at hand during review dramatically improves the quality of your analysis.

review.title: Review
review.body: After each game, rate your KPIs on the selected objectives, add timestamped notes on the timeline, and log your impressions. You can also access external reviews shared by other players.
review.why: Structured review turns a simple 'GG / FF' into concrete learning.

history.title: History
history.body: Browse all your past games with filters by account, role, and champion. Jump to the review or detailed stats for any game.
history.why: Spot recurring patterns by browsing your complete history.

stats.title: Detailed Stats
stats.body: Explore detailed stats for each game: CS, vision, damage, gold, timeline, and rank average comparison.
stats.why: Hard numbers to understand what worked and what didn't in every game.

analytics.title: Analytics / Progression
analytics.body: Visualize your skill progression over time with trend charts. Compare fundamental assessments, session averages, and track your trends by objective.
analytics.why: Measure real progress instead of relying on gut feeling.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Manage your Riot accounts, configure auto-recording (folder, audio sources, mic), Discord webhooks, YouTube links, and experimental options.
settings.why: Tailor Ascend to your setup for a smooth workflow.

tips.title: Tips & Shortcuts
items: Enable auto-recording in settings so you never forget to capture a game.
Use timestamped notes during review to mark key moments in the game using the 'mark' button to gain more time
Compare fundamental assessments to see your progress between evaluations.
Filter by account and role in history to analyze a specific champion pool.
Share your reviews via Discord webhook to get feedback from your community.
